mapper.select: SELECT directory.id, CASE directory.diagnosis_category WHEN N'0' THEN N'WESTERN' WHEN N'1' THEN N'TRADITIONAL' END AS diagnosis_category, directory.disease_code, directory.disease_name, directory.mnemonic_code, directory.remark, directory.source_created_at, directory.source_disease_id, directory.latest_batch_id, batches.batch_no AS latest_batch_no, directory.last_seen_at FROM md_icd10_diagnosis directory INNER JOIN md_sync_batch batches ON batches.id = directory.latest_batch_id ORDER BY directory.diagnosis_category, directory.disease_name, directory.disease_code, directory.id OFFSET #{query.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{query.pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT CASE diagnosis_category WHEN N'0' THEN N'WESTERN' WHEN N'1' THEN N'TRADITIONAL' END AS diagnosis_category, COUNT(1) AS total FROM md_icd10_diagnosis WHERE source_system_code = 'PRIMARY_HIS' GROUP BY diagnosis_category ORDER BY diagnosis_category
